Who approved CN-TFE's oil pressure switch replacement for return to service?

Source: WO-SCAN, section 
Work orders WO-2021-0544, WO-2024-0071, WO-2026-0388 (scanned)
Work order WO-2021-0544: CN-TFE, oil pressure switch replacement (scanned)
Work performed

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11 paragraph (g)(6) and Cessna Service Bulletin SB 07-79-01.

Removed switch P/N 83278 at 3,000.4 hours since installation. Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks.

Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-014.

Performed by: Y. Alaoui

Approved for return to service: A. Tazi
